entries.title: Ephesians 5:1
segments: Therefore be followers of God, as dear children.

entries.title: Ephesians 5:2
segments: And walk in love, as Christ also has loved us, and has given Himself for us as an offering and a sacrifice to God for a sweet smelling savor.

entries.title: Ephesians 5:3
segments: For let fornication and all uncleanness or covetousness not be once named among you, as becomes saints,

entries.title: Ephesians 5:4
segments: neither baseness, foolish talking, jesting, which are not becoming, but rather giving of thanks.

entries.title: Ephesians 5:5
segments: For you know this, that no fornicator, or unclean person, or covetous [one] (who is an idolater), has any inheritance in the kingdom of Christ and of God.

entries.title: Ephesians 5:6
segments: Let no man deceive you with vain words, for because of these things the wrath of God comes upon the children of disobedience.

entries.title: Ephesians 5:7
segments: Therefore do not be partakers with them.

entries.title: Ephesians 5:8
segments: For you were once darkness, but now [you are] light in [the] Lord; walk as children of light

entries.title: Ephesians 5:9
segments: (for the fruit of the Spirit [is] in all goodness and righteousness and truth),

entries.title: Ephesians 5:10
segments: proving what is acceptable to the Lord.

entries.title: Ephesians 5:11
segments: And have no fellowship with the unfruitful works of darkness, but rather reprove [them].

entries.title: Ephesians 5:12
segments: For it is a shame even to speak of those things which are done by them in secret.

entries.title: Ephesians 5:13
segments: But all things that are reproved are made manifest by the light, for whatever makes manifest [is] light.

entries.title: Ephesians 5:14
segments: Therefore he says, "Awake, sleeping ones! And arise from the dead, and Christ shall give you light."

entries.title: Ephesians 5:15
segments: See then that you walk circumspectly, not as fools, but as wise,

entries.title: Ephesians 5:16
segments: redeeming the time, because the days are evil.

entries.title: Ephesians 5:17
segments: Therefore do not be unwise, but understand what the will of the Lord [is].

entries.title: Ephesians 5:18
segments: And do not be drunk with wine, in which is excess, but be filled with the Spirit,

entries.title: Ephesians 5:19
segments: speaking to yourselves in psalms and hymns and spiritual songs, singing and making melody in your heart to the Lord;

entries.title: Ephesians 5:20
segments: always giving thanks for all things to God [the] Father in the name of our Lord Jesus Christ,

entries.title: Ephesians 5:21
segments: submitting yourselves to one another in the fear of God.

entries.title: Ephesians 5:22
segments: Wives, submit yourselves to [your] own husbands, as to the Lord.

entries.title: Ephesians 5:23
segments: For the husband is the head of the wife, even as Christ [is] the head of the church; and He is the Savior of the body.

entries.title: Ephesians 5:24
segments: Therefore as the church is subject to Christ, so [let] the wives [be] to their own husbands in everything.

entries.title: Ephesians 5:25
segments: Husbands, love your wives, even as Christ also loved the church and gave Himself for it,

entries.title: Ephesians 5:26
segments: that He might sanctify and cleanse it with the washing of water by the Word,

entries.title: Ephesians 5:27
segments: that He might present it to Himself [as] the glorious church, without spot or wrinkle or any such things, but that it should be holy and without blemish.

entries.title: Ephesians 5:28
segments: So men ought to love their wives as their [own] bodies. He who loves his wife loves himself.

entries.title: Ephesians 5:29
segments: For no man ever yet hated his [own] flesh, but nourishes and cherishes it, even as the Lord loves the church.

entries.title: Ephesians 5:30
segments: For we are members of His body, of His flesh, and of His bones.

entries.title: Ephesians 5:31
segments: "For this cause a man shall leave his father and mother and shall be joined to his wife, and the two of them shall be one flesh."

entries.title: Ephesians 5:32
segments: This is a great mystery, but I speak concerning Christ and the church.

entries.title: Ephesians 5:33
segments: But also let everyone of you in particular so love his wife even as himself, and the wife that she defers to her husband.
